Your default browser is the app that opens when you click a link in an email, document, or another application. You can change your default browser at any time using your device’s system settings.

__TOC__

=What is a default browser?=
Your default browser is the application your operating system uses to open web links. When you click a link, it opens in your default browser. You can have multiple browsers installed on your device at the same time, but only one can be your default browser for that device.

{note}'''Note''': Changing your default browser does not remove other browsers.{/note}

{for linux}
==Change your default browser on Linux (GNOME)==
#Open {menu Activities}.
#Type and click on {menu Default Applications}.
#Under {menu Web}, select your preferred browser.

==Change your default browser on Linux (KDE Plasma)==
#Open {menu System Settings}.
#Go to {menu Applications} > {menu Default Applications}.
#Under {menu Web Browser}, choose your preferred browser.
#Click on {button Apply}, then {button OK}.
{/for}

{for win11}
==Change your default browser on Windows 11==
#Click the Start [[Image:Windows11StartButton]] menu button and open {menu Settings} (or press the ''Windows'' key {key [[Image:Windows11Key]] + I}).
#Select {menu Apps} from the sidebar.
#Click {button Default apps}.
#Search for or select the browser you want to use in the {button Set defaults for applications} box.
#Click {button Set default} at the top.
;[[Image:defaultbrowser11]]
;[[Image:defaultapps11]]

{note}'''Note''': Windows 11 may list file and link types (like HTTP and HTTPS). Using {button Set default} applies the most common settings automatically.{/note}
{/for}

{for win10}
==Change your default browser on Windows 10==
#Click the Start [[Image:Windows10StartButton]] menu button and open {menu Settings}.
#Click {menu Apps}.
#Select {menu Default apps}.
#Scroll to {button Web browser}.
#Click the current browser and choose a new one.
{/for}

{for mac}
==Change your default browser on macOS==
#Open {menu System Settings} from the Apple menu.
#Click {menu Desktop & Dock}.
#Scroll to {button Default web browser}.
#Choose your preferred browser from the dropdown.
;[[Image:desktopdock]]
{note}'''Note''': On macOS Monterey (12) or earlier, go to {menu System Preferences} > {menu General} to find this setting.{/note}
{/for}

==Set your default browser from within Firefox==
You can also start the process from within Firefox, if you wish to make Firefox your default browser:
#Open '''Firefox'''.
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#At the top of the {for not fx152}{menu General}{/for}{for fx152}{menu Account and sync} or {menu Home and startup}{/for} page, click the {button Make default} button.{note}'''Note:''' If Firefox is already your default browser, the button will be missing.{/note}
For more information{for win10,win11} and additional steps you may need to take{/for}, see {for mac,linux,winxp,win7,win8}[[Make Firefox your default browser]]{/for}{for win10,win11}[[Make Firefox your default browser on Windows]]{/for}.
